title: Hungary and the European Union, 2004–2026
grammar: Recap: concession with ellenére and dacára
goal: I can sum up Hungary's membership of the European Union and the debate before the election of 2026, with dates (*tagság, szuverenitás, elnökség*).
I can state a concession with *ellenére* and *dacára* (*a viták ellenére*).
I can report, with attribution, how each side described the membership.
